title: Planning source size guard
description: Objective: make the permanent <=250-line production-and-test rule mechanically enforceable for the planning core. Deliverable: packages/core/src/planning/planning-source-size.test.ts enumerates every TypeScript source/test/support file in its directory using cross-platform Node paths, counts LF/CRLF/CR physical lines equivalently, and fails with the complete sorted offender list when any file exceeds 250 lines. Hard dependencies: the five planning decomposition children of task-1ade51c0 must land first. NOT in scope: reducer behavior, generated files, repository-wide sizing, or excluding inconvenient planning files. Owned path: packages/core/src/planning/planning-source-size.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: The guard includes every packages/core/src/planning/*.ts production, test, fixture, and support file without a hand-maintained allowlist.
LF, CRLF, and CR inputs produce the same physical-line count, the threshold is exactly 250, and failures name all offenders in deterministic sorted order.
A local mutation/fixture proving 251 lines fails and 250 lines passes is encoded in the test without leaving generated or scratch files.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0 after all planning TypeScript files satisfy the guard.
taskRails: This is the final hardening child for the planning-file decomposition; do not start until its five named predecessor refactors are DONE.
The guard must cover production and tests equally; no basename, suffix, or current-file exception.
Use Node path/file APIs portably across Windows, macOS, and Linux; leave no generated/scratch files.
Commit only the explicit owned path; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.
